sample.corpus_note: The committed extract is all REG games from the source; it does not hold every game ever played (5,336 decided games in the 2006-2026 window here). The brief's '136-game log' is the 2026 season slice in data/verified/model/predictions_log.json and is a separate, smaller corpus kept for continuity; this study does not use it as its sample.
sample.price_coverage_note: Seasons 1999-2005 carry no two-sided price and are excluded by the registered sample rule. No price is imputed.
sample.orientation_note: spread_line is the canonical closing line with the HOME side signed positive, so a negative line means the home club is favoured. With hfa ~ 1.7 points, own_spread_home = -8.6 in BUF @ NYJ means the model makes the HOME club (NYJ) an 8.6-point favourite, i.e. the model and the close (NYJ -8.5) agree. This convention is printed on the site because reading it the other way inverts every edge.

own_line_fit.design: margin = hfa + rest_coef*rest_diff + net[home] - net[away]; total = intercept + pace[home] + pace[away]

brier.reading: A positive difference means the market's probability was the better forecast. A negative difference with an interval entirely below zero would be the first evidence in this repository that the own line adds information.
brier.benchmark_note: The benchmark is the de-vigged closing moneyline, not a coin flip. A coin flip is not a benchmark; a market is.

ablation.what_changed: only the presence of two availability columns in the margin fit
ablation.verdict: The availability features add nothing measurable: the interval on the difference contains zero.
ablation.brier_note: The Brier panel above is computed from the WITH-availability model, so the two panels agree.
ablation.why_not_a_penalty: A fixed points-per-starter penalty asserts a magnitude. This ablation measures one, and reports the interval, so a reviewer can see whether the measurement is distinguishable from noise.

luck.power_note: Two-sided test at 5% with 80% power, on hit rate. It says how many decided bets a genuine edge of that size needs before it is visible at all. With 25751 decided bets in total across all twelve rules, only edges of roughly 2 percentage points or larger are even in principle detectable, and each individual rule holds a fraction of that total.

controls.reading: An information-free rule loses almost exactly the vig, as it must. Any claimed edge has to be measured against THIS, not against 50%.

luck.honest_summary: No rule removed luck. Zero of twelve rules passed every gate; the best in-sample result belongs to a rule whose game-cluster interval contains zero and which fails the untouched holdout.

correlation.rule: Publish only where n >= 25 paired observations; n is printed with every value.

rows.kind: own line vs the closing line

correlation.not_computed: Prop-level and same-game-parlay correlations are NOT published because no observed prop price exists in any source here. A correlation between two legs whose prices cannot be observed is not a betting number.
